title: Supergirl #6 DC April 2006 Nightwing Flamebird Kandor Greg Rucka Ed Benes
conditionDescription: Front cover bright with light wear; black back cover shows scuffing and white specks of color loss. See photos.
descriptionText:
Supergirl #6 (April 2006), DC Comics - "Nightwing & Flamebird... the Dynamic Duo of Kandor!" Written by Greg Rucka, art by Ed Benes and Norm Rapmund. Direct sales, $2.99 cover price.

Back cover: Above the Influence (Partnership for a Drug-Free America) ad.

Condition: front cover bright with light handling wear; the black back cover shows scuffing and small white specks of color loss (see photos).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
